question: A company is investigating different options for IT automation tools. The IT team has experience with Python programming language and scripting using a declarative language. The proposed tool should be easy to set up and should not require installing an agent on target devices. The team will also need to build custom modules based on the Python programming language to extend the tool's functionality. Which automation tool should be used to meet these requirements?
theory: Ansible playbooks are declarative YAML, the tool is agentless (pushing over SSH with no software installed on target nodes), and its modules are ordinary Python programs that a Python-literate team can extend or write from scratch — this exact combination of easy setup, no agent, and Python-based extensibility matches the requirements, whereas Puppet/Chef require an installed agent and NX-API is a device interface, not a general automation tool. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 17 — Evaluate Automation and Orchestration Technologies)
